decisions.reason: The Magento 2 shop template is cheap to maintain and still uncertain in value, so keeping it as an option for agency customers costs little, though its mere mention suggests limited commitment.
The responsive website template has low upkeep and its prospects are not yet resolved, so the option stays open, even though only a brief mention signals it is peripheral.
Premium support fits the firm's core agency-focused 24/7 service strategy and builds on existing centralized support operations, making it low-cost to keep and likely valuable.
The version management tool has its own page and matches the firm's aim of tools that reduce recurring operational work, so further commitment is justified while value resolves.
The data processing contract tool meets ongoing GDPR demand, has its own page and is cheap to run online, so there is no evidence yet to warrant abandoning it.
